author: GNiendorf
body:
#### Summary
Six changes to mkFit and the HLT LST iteration that recover real tracks the HLT loses: high-pT tracks in dense jets, and displaced tracks that LST finds but the HLT drops. They apply to the LST step only.

Slides with more info: [LST-MKfit-QCD-Improvements.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32804473/LST-MKfit-QCD-Improvements.pdf), [HLT-Displaced.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32865474/HLT-Displaced.pdf)

#### What changed
**This PR (cmssw)**

High-pT tracks in jets:
- New duplicate cleaner `phase2:clean_duplicates_sharedhits_pixelpriority`: when exactly one track of a duplicate pair has at least two pixel hits, that track is kept. Two tracks that both have pixel hits but share none are not duplicates. The existing cleaner is unchanged. Pixel layers come from `TrackerInfo`, so the cleaner does not depend on the Phase-2 layer numbering.
- Backward-fit outlier rejection: hits whose chi2 increment exceeds 20 become missing hits, for tracks above 5 GeV (at most 3 hits per track; three new iteration JSON members, `m_backward_fit_outlier_chi2`, `m_backward_fit_max_outliers`, `m_backward_fit_outlier_min_pt`, off by default and set in the LST-step JSON).

Displaced tracks (the HLT lost 3-13% of the displaced tracks LST finds, mostly because mkFit's backward search attached wrong pixel hits to outer-tracker-only seeds and the final fit then rejected the whole track):
- mkFit backward search keeps an extension only if its new hits lie on at least 2 pixel layers (1 layer for candidates with |d0| < 2 cm); otherwise the candidate from before the search is restored (new ES parameters `backwardSearchMinPixelLayers` and `backwardSearchPromptMaxD0`; the default of 0 reproduces the previous output exactly).
- Outlier-tolerant final fit for `hltInitialStepTracks`: a copy of the default fitter allowing 6 outliers (fraction 0.5), without breaking the trajectory on two consecutive missing hits. The default strips a track with a few bad inner hits from its outer end until it dies. It is used only by the LST + mkFit initial step and is also loaded in the NGT scouting menu.
- Candidate pT cut 0.9 -> 0.85 GeV for |eta| < 1.4 in the mkFit output converter.

**cms-data (needed for the cleaner and the outlier settings)**
- https://github.com/cms-data/RecoTracker-MkFit/pull/22: the LST-step JSON selects the new cleaner and switches off the direction-only duplicate check (`dc_drth`), which removed real high-pT tracks in jets without looking at shared hits.
- All 16 JSONs get the three new keys (off except the LST step: chi2 20, at most 3 outliers, above 5 GeV). mkFit requires every schema key, and the current code does not know the new cleaner, so the cms-data update and this PR must go in together.
- The displaced-track settings are ES-producer parameters and need no cms-data change.
- Must be tested and merged together with the cms-data PR.

#### HLT results (Phase-2 menu, 5000 events each, hltGeneralTracks; with the cms-data change)
On current LST:
| | ttbar PU200 | QCD pT-hat 1.8-2.4 TeV, PU200 |
|---|---|---|
| Efficiency, pT > 100 GeV | 74.6 -> 76.8% | 31.6 -> 51.3% |
| Efficiency, pT 10-100 GeV | 91.1 -> 92.2% | 77.0 -> 87.1% |
| Displaced efficiency, r_vtx 2.5-10 cm | 69.1 -> 72.1% | 66.1 -> 72.2% |
| Displaced efficiency, r_vtx 10-30 cm | 67.1 -> 70.4% | 57.3 -> 61.3% |
| Displaced efficiency, r_vtx 30-60 cm | 45.3 -> 47.8% | 26.5 -> 30.3% |
| Fake rate, pT 10-40 GeV | 7.3 -> 7.2% | 18.4 -> 17.5% |
| Fake rate, pT > 100 GeV | 34.9 -> 34.1% | 11.2 -> 16.3% |
| Duplicate rate | 1.00 -> 1.10% | 0.97 -> 1.07% |

On top of the T5/T4 DNN retrain (https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52011):
| | ttbar PU200 | QCD pT-hat 1.8-2.4 TeV, PU200 |
|---|---|---|
| Efficiency, pT > 100 GeV | 75.7 -> 77.9% | 56.6 -> 71.1% |
| Efficiency, pT 10-100 GeV | 91.6 -> 92.4% | 84.4 -> 88.7% |
| Displaced efficiency, r_vtx 2.5-10 cm | 70.1 -> 73.2% | 70.2 -> 75.8% |
| Displaced efficiency, r_vtx 10-30 cm | 69.6 -> 73.1% | 67.5 -> 72.2% |
| Displaced efficiency, r_vtx 30-60 cm | 50.5 -> 53.5% | 38.3 -> 43.5% |
| Fake rate, pT 10-40 GeV | 4.8 -> 4.4% | 9.1 -> 7.5% |
| Fake rate, pT > 100 GeV | 26.2 -> 21.6% | 10.1 -> 10.2% |
| Duplicate rate | 1.02 -> 1.11% | 1.00 -> 1.10% |

On current LST the QCD fake rate above 100 GeV goes up (11.2% -> 16.3%); on top of the DNN retrain it stays flat. This PR should go in after the DNN retrain PR.

#### Timing
HLT (Phase-2 menu, ttbar PU200, 16 threads/streams per job, 2 runs each), measured for each part: the jet fixes leave the throughput unchanged (GPU memory within run-to-run variation); the displaced-track changes give CPU 26.8/26.7 -> 26.6/26.7 ev/s, GPU 27.6/27.6 -> 27.5/27.4 ev/s.

#### Plots
Full MTV plots, 5000 events:
- current LST vs + this PR (mkFit fixes + displaced recovery): [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/pr281/merged2_ttbar/plots_hlt.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/pr281/merged2_qcd/plots_hlt.html)
- current LST vs + mkFit fixes vs + mkFit fixes + displaced recovery: [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/pr281/merged3_ttbar/plots_hlt.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/pr281/merged3_qcd/plots_hlt.html)
- current LST vs + mkFit fixes vs + displaced recovery vs + T5/T4 DNN retrain (https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52011): [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/pr281/merged4_ttbar/plots_hlt.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/pr281/merged4_qcd/plots_hlt.html)
